about_the_game:
Enjoy the original soundtrack for Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch, composed by Clark Aboud. Immerse yourself in this evocative collection and relive the tension of each run, the thrill of a hard-won victory, and all the in-between.

Credits

Music Composed and Produced by Clark Aboud

Performed by Sofia Session Orchestra

Conductor - Lyubomir Denev Jr.

Session Producer - Georgi Elenkov PhD

Sound Engineers - Plamen Penchev, Angelia Vihrova, Vladislav Boyadjiev @Sofia Session Studio

Contracting Services - Boris Radilov, Delyan Kolev @FourForMusic Ltd.

Concertmaster - Irina Stoyanova

Session Librarian - Velislava Georgieva

Historical Bowed Strings - Niccolo Seligmann

Woodwinds - Josh Plotner
